E.notes: Completed 2026-09-10. Two native GRPO updates with verl's own core_algos (compute_grpo_outcome_advantage + compute_policy_loss, PPO clip 0.2), dual-GPU FSDP2 world=2, LoRA-only trainable 34.41M, lr 1e-6, one update round per batch, synchronous checkpoints. P0->P1 (loss -0.521187, grad_norm 0.495278, 1344 changed tensors) and P1->P2 (loss -0.357142, grad_norm 0.384278, 1344 changed). Logprob comparison of training-side vs rollout logprobs over masked tokens: round 1 mean 0.02768 / P99 0.16145 nat, round 2 mean 0.02619 / P99 0.17427 nat -- both inside the 0.05 / 0.5 thresholds. Checkpoint-boundary recovery at P1: 672 LoRA tensors bitwise identical on reload, gradient flow resumes (grad_norm 1.0976), no batch replayed. Both P1 and P2 proven usable by real Pi execution (P1 via r2b, P2 via r3b: 1 PASSED/3 FAILED, all VALID/ELIGIBLE). Round 2's first attempt was rejected for zero intra-group reward variance and resampled, per the documented pre-update gate. Rollout backend is the repaired vLLM served through an OpenAI bridge (Pi -> bridge -> vLLM). Limitation: orchestration is a driver around verl's native algorithm code, not RayPPOTrainer; the Ray hybrid-replica path was made importable/gated correctly but not driven end-to-end.

F.notes: Completed 2026-09-10. Holdout fixed before the run: Mbpp/2, Mbpp/3, Mbpp/4, Mbpp/6 -- none used in this RL run (D/E used Mbpp/118 only). NOT claimed as SFT-unseen: overlap with the SFT data was not verified. Identical tools/workspace/timeout/sampling for both arms, one real Pi episode per task per policy, served by the repaired vLLM. Effect result: P0 0/4 passed (10 model calls, 16 tool events), P2 0/4 passed (4 model calls, 0 tool events); all 8 episodes execution_validity VALID. No pass-rate difference observed; the only measurable difference is behavioural (P2 emitted zero tool calls on all four held-out tasks). Explicitly a 4-task smoke evaluation, not a statistical claim, and no improvement is claimed. Integration conclusion and effect conclusion are reported separately.

G.notes: verl's own trainer now owns the loop: verl.trainer.main_ppo -> RayPPOTrainer.fit() ran one complete GRPO step (smoke25, 2026-09-11): 16 real Pi episodes certified -> advantages -> update_actor 117.6s -> update_weights 2.98s -> global_step_1 checkpoint; P1 adapter sha256 f0ddcac8... differs from the frozen P0 6db6a40c..., so the update is real, not a no-op. Rollouts were multi-turn (num_turns mean 2.31, max 5) with every truncated turn accepted as a legitimate action, and rollout logprobs matched the trainer's recomputation (rollout_actor_probs_pearson_corr 0.99951). 5.3 item 2 therefore upgraded to satisfied. Item 9 stays PARTIAL: the framework synced weights in place, but no rollout after the sync consumed them yet -- smoke26 (total_epochs=2) was meant to show exactly that and was instead refused for zero intra-group reward variance (16/16 FAILED), which is the variance gate working. Closing item 9 needs a run that reaches step 2, i.e. a group containing at least one solve; at the observed ~1/16 solve rate a 16-sample group has ~60% odds, so it needs more samples per group or an easier task -- an experiment-design choice, not code. The project claim is therefore NOT upgraded.
